items.title: Nvidia unveils AI breakthrough that goes beyond chatbots
items.summary:
Nvidia Corp. (NVDA, Financials) unveiled its GR00T 2 robotics model and Isaac Lab 3.0 programming tools, advancing its attempts to apply artificial intelligence to physical devices.  
  
The business unveiled the technique at the Conference on Robot Learning in Austin, Texas.  
  
GR00T 2 is an open robotics world model from the Cosmos platform from Nvidia. It was trained on both robot and human data, including 100,000 hours of open-source video from a person's point of view. [...] The model was able to do 40 out of 50 jobs it was tested on without task-specific examples, Nvidia says.  
  
GR00T 2 performed successfully on 50 tasks, each with a single demonstration, with a success rate of 71%. That rose to 95% after five demonstrations.  
  
The model may also transfer taught abilities to other robot designs, without the need for being demonstrated on each machine. [...] Nvidia stated GR0T 2 was among the top three models on a few robotics benchmarks, including RoboCasa365 and RoboLab.  
  
The system may interact with AI agents through an application programming interface, perhaps enabling autonomous systems to coordinate more complicated operations.  
  
The initiative expands Nvidia's business beyond selling processors to include providing software and models for robots.

items.title: How are we all feeling about AI right now? – Deseret News
items.summary: Faster medical research and new treatments; earlier, more accurate diagnosis of disease; and scientific discovery beyond health occupied the top spots for both polling samples. Both audiences also matched up in their next three AI hopefulness rankings of improving accessibility for people with disabilities; lowering the cost of goods and services; and taking over dangerous or repetitive work. [...] Fast-emerging artificial intelligence tools and software are stoking plenty of concerns as an increasing number of AI-driven misdeeds are reported. And alongside those incidents, predictions are coming from some within the AI development world that the technology could advance to the point of threatening the whole of humanity. [...] Johns Hopkins University professor and AI researcher Christopher Honey reviewed the new polling data and, in a Deseret News interview, said he sees a notable convergence between the Deseret News poll’s findings on artificial intelligence and what he discovered in his own national polling — people want safeguards around AI, but they also hope the technology will deliver meaningful advances.

results.input: Giải giúp mình bài toán tích phân: nguyên hàm của x^2 là gì?

result.actual_text:
Nguyên hàm của hàm số $x^2$ được tính theo công thức tính nguyên hàm cơ bản của hàm số lũy thừa $\int x^n dx = \frac{x^{n+1}}{n+1} + C$ (với $n \neq -1$).

Áp dụng vào bài toán với $n = 2$:

$$\int x^2 \, dx = \frac{x^{2+1}}{2+1} + C = \frac{x^3}{3} + C$$

Vậy nguyên hàm của $x^2$ là **$\frac{x^3}{3} + C$** (trong đó $C$ là hằng số thực).

The caps hit users without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license, affect web, desktop and mobile apps, and cover features including image generation. Microsoft has not published the numeric limits and administrators cannot view or modify them; users only learn they've hit a cap via in-product [...] Artificial Analysis shipped Decision Index v2 on Nov 8, lifting private-benchmark weight from 25% to 45% and rewarding calibrated confidence alongside accuracy. Decision models Drex Max v1.1 from Nace AI and GLiDE v1.2 from Fastino Labs tie at 73, with Base Labs' Mammoth 27B at 72; Claude Haiku 5.5 (Max) tops the LM side at 77 and GPT-6 Luna (Max) scores 76 at higher cost and latency. The new AA-Paperclip component runs 1,500 real documents (resumes, receipts, invoices, research papers) and [...] Axon is putting $1.2B into autonomous-drone maker Skydio at a $5.2B pre-money valuation, lifting its stake from roughly 15% to 37% through a mix of ~60% cash and ~40% Axon stock, with only $255M of new primary capital and the rest secondary. The deal makes Axon the exclusive distributor of Skydio drones to US and Canadian public-safety agencies, cementing a public-safety drone duopoly. Axon stock fell ~18% on the news, pressured in part by $130M of counter-drone orders slipping beyond 2026.
